app.name: Trado
app.description: A personal journal for cryptocurrency spot trades.

auth.phoneHint: International format, or an Iranian number starting with 09.
auth.otpLater: One-time codes are not enabled yet. Sign in with your password.

dashboard.title: Portfolio
dashboard.subtitle: Figures come from the trades you record and the current prices you enter. Nothing is fetched from the market.
dashboard.realizedHint: Average cost inside each trade. Buys and sells are never matched across trades.
dashboard.cashHint: Initial capital plus sold minus bought. Each entry keeps the rate from that day.
dashboard.unrealizedHint: What remains in each trade, valued at the current price you enter. If a price is missing, this figure is left blank.
dashboard.performanceHint: (Portfolio value − initial capital) / initial capital. One USD percentage, so a later Toman rate does not rewrite it.
dashboard.missingCapital: Set initial capital to calculate this.
dashboard.missingPrices: Enter a current price for every open asset to calculate this.
dashboard.oversoldNote: {count} trades sold more than they bought. Open the trade to review the grouping.
dashboard.performancePending: Performance against initial capital is not calculated yet. Live market prices are not tracked.
dashboard.emptyBody: Record your first trade to start tracking your portfolio.

trades.title: Trades
trades.subtitle: A trade is a group of buys and sells you put together yourself.
trades.emptyBody: Nothing is matched automatically. You decide which entries belong together.
trades.createSubtitle: Start a trade with its first buy or sell.
trades.solveHint: Enter any two of quantity, unit price, and total. The third is calculated.
trades.rateHint: Toman per 1 USD at the time of this entry.
trades.noAssetsBody: An asset is the coin or token this trade is about.
trades.noActiveBody: Activate an asset, or add one, before recording a trade.
trades.deleteTradeConfirm: Delete this trade and every entry in it? This cannot be undone.
trades.titleHint: Optional. The asset name is used when this is empty.
trades.methodNote: Realized P/L uses average cost inside this trade only. Unrealized P/L values what remains at the current price you enter. Buys and sells are not matched across trades.
trades.sortHint: Highest and lowest use total P/L when a price is set, otherwise realized P/L.
trades.stepAssetBody: Choose the coin or token this trade is about.
trades.stepSideBody: The first entry of a new trade has to be a buy.
trades.stepValuesBody: Any two of quantity, price, and total. The third is calculated.
trades.firstMustBuy: A new trade starts with a buy. You can add a sell after it is saved.

assets.title: Assets
assets.subtitle: Coins and tokens you record yourself. Current prices are entered by hand.
assets.priceHint: A manual price for now. A later source can replace this without changing past entries.
assets.priceRateNote: This rate converts the current price to Toman. It does not change past entries or realized P/L.
assets.iconHint: Optional. PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 80 KB.
assets.activeHint: Inactive assets stay on existing trades, but cannot be selected for a new trade.
assets.name: Name
assets.emptyBody: Add a symbol such as BTC before recording a trade.
assets.inUse: This asset is used by a trade and cannot be deleted.
assets.symbolHint: Letters and numbers, up to 12 characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phoneLocked: Changing your number will require a one-time code. That is not enabled yet.
settings.name: Name
settings.currencyHint: Both currencies stay visible. This chooses which one leads.
settings.capitalHint: The USD you started with, and the Toman rate on that day.
settings.capitalRateNote: This rate is stored with this capital record. A later rate does not rewrite past trades.

validation.positive: Enter a number greater than zero.
validation.date_future: Date cannot be in the future.
validation.date_past: Date is too far in the past.
validation.need_two: Enter two of quantity, unit price, and total.
validation.insufficient_quantity: This trade does not hold enough quantity for that sell.
validation.invalid_icon: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
validation.icon_too_large: Icon must be 80 KB or smaller.

errors.validation_error: Check the form and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: Phone number or password is incorrect.
errors.phone_taken: An account with this number already exists.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.asset_in_use: This asset is used by a trade.
errors.asset_exists: You already have an asset with this symbol.
errors.insufficient_quantity: This trade does not hold enough quantity for that sell.
errors.asset_inactive: This asset is inactive. Activate it before starting a trade.
